title: Pager WAL discovery and rollback exclusive locking

scope.rationale: pagerOpenWalIfPresent reconciles the filesystem WAL with database size and mode, while sqlite3PagerExclusiveLock preserves sticky errors, treats WAL mode as a no-op, and acquires EXCLUSIVE for rollback writers through the busy policy.
excluded_responsibilities: WAL frame parsing, shared-index recovery, and checkpointing
Rollback journal synchronization after EXCLUSIVE acquisition

external_source_responsibilities: VFS access/delete report and remove filesystem WAL names
Wal.open and Wal.recover own WAL parsing and shared-index state
Pager callers hold a read lock for discovery and an active write transaction for exclusiveLock
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete functions and generated blocks are assigned; beginRead consumes WAL discovery and rollback commit synchronization consumes exclusiveLock.

inputs: Mutable Pager with read lock for WAL discovery
Mutable rollback writer Pager for exclusive locking
outputs: Exact VFS, WAL, sticky-error, busy, or success ResultCode
contracts.ownership: WAL discovery may initialize or deinitialize the Pager-owned Wal; exclusive locking transfers no ownership.
contracts.state_and_results: Memory-backed discovery is a no-op. Missing WAL clears any stale owner and selects rollback mode. Existing WAL with a zero-byte database is deleted and rollback mode selected. Existing WAL with nonempty database opens or recovers the Wal and selects WAL mode. exclusiveLock returns a sticky Pager error first, returns success without database-file locking in WAL mode, and otherwise waits for EXCLUSIVE.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Discovery performs VFS access and possibly file-size, delete, WAL open/recovery, and shared-memory I/O while a read lock is held. exclusiveLock uses the Pager busy callback only through waitOnLock.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Discovery publishes mode only after successful branch completion. Failed WAL open/recovery leaves beginRead cleanup responsible for owner teardown and unlock. Failed exclusive acquisition preserves writer state and prior lock level for retry.

representation_differences: Production Pager uses one wal_mode boolean for the currently selected mode rather than a separate source journalMode enum.
Pager.error_code is an exact ResultCode value rather than the source integer errCode.
Memory-backed detection uses the VFS-open result flag; temp-file opening remains outside the current Pager public constructor.

oracle.protocol: Exercise absent WAL rollback selection, zero-byte database stale-WAL deletion, nonempty committed-WAL open/recovery, WAL-mode exclusive no-op, sticky-error forwarding, rollback EXCLUSIVE busy callback stop, and successful retry after the competing reader closes.
oracle.normalization: Compare exact ResultCode, boolean mode, owner presence, file existence, lock level, and callback count.

assurance.oom: Wal.open allocation failure propagates and beginRead cleanup owns teardown; exclusiveLock allocates nothing.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Read lock excludes the source WAL deletion race; VFS/Wal owners preserve exact I/O failures.
assurance.malformed_input: Malformed existing WAL errors through Wal.recover; typed Pager state and assertions constrain exclusiveLock.
assurance.continuation: Failed beginRead returns to open; failed EXCLUSIVE retains writer state and lock for retry.
assurance.performance: Constant metadata work plus bounded WAL recovery; busy retry is caller-controlled.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig beginRead and rollback journal synchronization
integration.native_call_path: beginRead invokes openWalIfPresent after shared-lock and external-version checks; syncJournalForCommit invokes exclusiveLock before journal durability work.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Inline beginRead access/open logic and direct commit waitOnLock call are retired in favor of these helpers.

independent_review.notes: Requires temp/no-lock and pinned-C branch traces, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect explicit temporary Pager construction and locking-mode configuration.
Add pinned-C branch trace for missing, stale-empty, and nonempty WAL cases.
